with flow/merge/finite/typed-3bb5395ea4c6fe37bd1bf03c196bf79c1991d7b2f48962943f955d1c065fc321 as BotReentryResults
with flow/zip/feedback/typed-9b873455e40a4be09c2b17b32bffedb40317f9a66d764188ce3640356c0d5754 as BotReentryRequestGate
with flow/zip/feedback/typed-9b873455e40a4be09c2b17b32bffedb40317f9a66d764188ce3640356c0d5754/paired as BotReentryRequestPair
with storage/block-read/request as BlockReadRequest
with storage/block-read/result as BlockReadResult
with storage/block-read/identity as BlockReadPermit
with machine/usb/control/request as UsbControlRequest
with machine/usb/control/result as UsbControlResult
with machine/usb/endpoint-read/request as UsbEndpointReadRequest
with machine/usb/endpoint-read/result as UsbEndpointReadResult
with machine/usb/endpoint-write/request as UsbEndpointWriteRequest
with machine/usb/endpoint-write/result as UsbEndpointWriteResult
with flow/zip/feedback/paired as BotReentryPair
# Exactly two caller requests. The first DATA must STALL after acknowledged
# native queue retirement. Source alone requests BOT reset(interface0), clear
# IN81 then OUT02. Only their exact zero-data acks permit original settlement.
# The second independent storage owner is selected only after settle1 returns.
# Native read ordinals are 0(stalled),1(DATA),2(CSW); both semantic owners begin
# at ordinal0. CBW tags1/2 are independent Source-owned protocol correlations.
# Root must opt in to read_only_reentry_approval and separately issue four
# distinct storage capability selections and the same three native USB owners.
type BotControlFacts = {
 descriptor: Boolean
 ack: Boolean
}
type BotReentryRead = {
 result: UsbEndpointReadResult
 ordinal: U64
 data: Boolean
 status: Boolean
 tag: U64
 residue: U64
 status_code: U64
}
# Feedback carries scalar facts; the genuine settle result is forwarded unchanged.
type BotReentrySettlement = {
 block_size: U64
 count: U64
 lba: U64
 ordinal: U64
 stalled: Boolean
 completed: Boolean
 actual: U64
 residue: U64
 short: Boolean
 length: U64
}
type BotReentryEvent =
 startup Bytes <= 2048B
 | closed
 | command BlockReadRequest
 | permit BlockReadPermit
 | control BotControlFacts
 | write UsbEndpointWriteResult
 | read BotReentryRead
 | settled BotReentrySettlement
type BotReentryState = {
 bank: Bytes <= 2048B
 request: BlockReadRequest
 permit: BlockReadPermit
 data: UsbEndpointReadResult
 phase: U64
 failed: Boolean
 terminal: Boolean
}
# A rejected active event terminates the physical state immediately. Its
# original storage submission remains retained for Root acknowledged cancel;
# this close never manufactures a settlement, permit or semantic result.
# Raw request descendants terminate at a selected authorizer. This route never
# sends raw payloads or closure observations into the physical state machine.
type BotReentryAuthorizationRequest =
 first BlockReadRequest
 | second BlockReadRequest
 | absent
type BotReentryRoute =
 ready BotReentryState
 | control BotReentryState
 | write BotReentryState
 | read BotReentryState
 | first-settle BotReentryState
 | second-settle BotReentryState
 | stopped BotReentryState
type BotReentryPending =
 running BotReentryState
 | stopped
type BotReentryTransition = {
 previous: BotReentryState
 event: BotReentryEvent
 accepted: Boolean
}
# This pure marker is for policy regressions only; it constructs no result.
# External results come only from the actual selected settle outputs.
type BotReentryEmission =
 emit
 | absent

# Exact topology/CSW predicates reused from mass-storage-read-native.
plot bot-reentry-control-event (
    result: UsbControlResult...| >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (control({ descriptor: !(. is completed) ? false : (.completed.transferred != 32 || .completed.short || sequence/length(.completed.input) != 32 ? false : (((((sequence/at(.completed.input, 0) == 9 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 1) == 2) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 2) == 32 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 3) == 0)) && ((sequence/at(.completed.input, 4) == 1 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 5) == 1) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 6) == 5 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 7) == 192))) && (((sequence/at(.completed.input, 8) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 9) == 9) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 10) == 4 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 11) == 0)) && ((sequence/at(.completed.input, 12) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 13) == 2) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 14) == 8 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 15) == 6)))) && ((((sequence/at(.completed.input, 16) == 80 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 17) == 0) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 18) == 7 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 19) == 5)) && ((sequence/at(.completed.input, 20) == 129 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 21) == 2) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 22) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 23) == 2))) && (((sequence/at(.completed.input, 24) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 25) == 7) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 26) == 5 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 27) == 2)) && ((sequence/at(.completed.input, 28) == 2 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 29) == 0) && (sequence/at(.completed.input, 30) == 2 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 31) == 0)))))), ack: !(. is completed) ? false : (.completed.transferred == 0 && !.completed.short && sequence/length(.completed.input) == 0) }))
plot bot-reentry-read-facts (
    result: UsbEndpointReadResult...| >> event: BotReentryRead...|
) = ({ result: ., ordinal: (. is completed ? .completed.ordinal : 0), data: (!(. is completed) ? false : (.completed.actual <= 512 && bytes/length(.completed.wire) == .completed.actual && .completed.short == (.completed.actual < 512))), status: (!(. is completed) ? false : (.completed.actual == 13 && !.completed.short && bytes/length(.completed.wire) == 13 ? ((((bytes/at(.completed.wire, 0) == 85 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 1) == 83) && (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 2) == 66 && (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 3) == 83 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 5) == 0))) && ((bytes/at(.completed.wire, 6) == 0 && (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 7) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 9) <= 2)) && (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 10) == 0 && (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 11) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 12) <= 2))))) : false)), tag: (!(. is completed) ? 0 : (bytes/length(.completed.wire) == 13 ? value/u64(bytes/at(.completed.wire, 4)) : 0)), residue: (!(. is completed) ? 0 : (bytes/length(.completed.wire) == 13 ? value/u64(bytes/at(.completed.wire, 8)) + value/u64(bytes/at(.completed.wire, 9)) * 256 : 0)), status_code: (!(. is completed) ? 0 : (bytes/length(.completed.wire) == 13 ? value/u64(bytes/at(.completed.wire, 12)) : 0)) })



plot bot-reentry-bootstrap (
    wire: Bytes <= 2048B >> event: BotReentryEvent
) = (bytes/length(.) <= 2048 ? startup(.) : closed(empty))
plot bot-reentry-start (
    event: BotReentryEvent...| >> state: BotReentryState...|
) = ({ bank: .startup, request: {block_size: 512, count: 1, lba: 0}, permit: {block_size: 512, count: 1, lba: 0, ordinal: 0}, data: unsupported(empty), phase: bytes/length(.startup) == 62 ? 0 : 16, failed: bytes/length(.startup) != 62, terminal: false })
plot bot-reentry-closed (
    event: BotReentryEvent...| >> closed: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (closed(empty))
plot bot-reentry-command (
    request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (command(.))
plot bot-reentry-permit (
    permit: BlockReadPermit...| <= 4096B >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (permit(.))
plot bot-reentry-settled (
    result: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (settled({ block_size: (. is stalled ? .stalled.block_size : (. is completed ? .completed.block_size : 0)), count: (. is stalled ? .stalled.count : (. is completed ? .completed.count : 0)), lba: (. is stalled ? .stalled.lba : (. is completed ? .completed.lba : 0)), ordinal: (. is stalled ? .stalled.ordinal : (. is completed ? .completed.ordinal : 0)), stalled: (. is stalled), completed: (. is completed), actual: (. is completed ? .completed.actual : 0), residue: (. is completed ? .completed.residue : 0), short: (. is completed ? .completed.short : false), length: (. is completed ? bytes/length(.completed.bytes) : 0) }))
plot bot-reentry-write-event (
    result: UsbEndpointWriteResult...| <= 4096B >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (write(.))
plot bot-reentry-read-observation (
    facts: BotReentryRead...| >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (read(.))
plot bot-reentry-read-event (
    result: UsbEndpointReadResult...| <= 4096B >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) {
 result >> bot-reentry-read-facts() >> bot-reentry-read-observation() >> event
}
plot bot-reentry-command-event (
    pair: BotReentryPair...| >> event: BotReentryEvent...|
) = (.1)
plot bot-reentry-raw-authorization (
    pair: BotReentryRequestPair...| >> route: BotReentryAuthorizationRequest...|
) = (.0.failed || .0.terminal ? absent(empty) : (.0.phase == 0 ? first(.1) : (.0.phase == 10 ? second(.1) : absent(empty))))
plot bot-reentry-route (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> route: BotReentryRoute...|
) = (.terminal || .phase > 16 || .phase == 1 || .phase == 11 ? stopped(.) : (.failed ? ready(.) : (.phase == 0 || .phase == 10 || .phase == 16 ? ready(.) : (.phase == 9 ? first-settle(.) : (.phase == 15 ? second-settle(.) : (.phase == 4 || .phase == 12 ? write(.) : (.phase == 5 || .phase == 13 || .phase == 14 ? read(.) : control(.))))))))
plot bot-reentry-pending (
    route: BotReentryRoute...| >> pending: BotReentryPending...|
) = (. is stopped ? stopped(empty) : (. is ready ? running(.ready) : (. is first-settle ? running(.first-settle) : (. is second-settle ? running(.second-settle) : (. is control ? running(.control) : (. is write ? running(.write) : running(.read)))))))
plot bot-reentry-authorization (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B
) = (.request)
plot bot-reentry-control-request (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> request: UsbControlRequest...| <= 4096B
) = ({ setup: .phase == 2 ? 0x0020000002000680 : (.phase == 3 ? 0x0000000000010900 : (.phase == 6 ? 0x000000000000ff21 : (.phase == 7 ? 0x0000008100000102 : 0x0000000200000102))), output: [] })
plot bot-reentry-write-request (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> request: UsbEndpointWriteRequest...| <= 4096B
) = ({ wire: bytes/window(.bank, .phase == 4 ? 0 : 31, 31) })
plot bot-reentry-read-request (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> request: UsbEndpointReadRequest...| <= 4096B
) = ({ length: .phase == 14 ? 13 : 512 })
plot bot-reentry-first-candidate (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> candidate: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) = (stalled({ block_size: .permit.block_size, count: .permit.count, lba: .permit.lba, ordinal: .permit.ordinal }))
plot bot-reentry-second-candidate (
    state: BotReentryState...| >> candidate: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) = (.data is completed ? (.data.completed.actual == 512 && bytes/length(.data.completed.wire) == 512 && !.data.completed.short ? completed({ actual: 512, block_size: .permit.block_size, bytes: .data.completed.wire, count: .permit.count, lba: .permit.lba, ordinal: .permit.ordinal, residue: 0, short: false }) : command-failed({ block_size: .permit.block_size, count: .permit.count, lba: .permit.lba, ordinal: .permit.ordinal })) : command-failed({ block_size: .permit.block_size, count: .permit.count, lba: .permit.lba, ordinal: .permit.ordinal }))

plot bot-reentry-accept (
    pair: BotReentryPair...| >> transition: BotReentryTransition...|
) = ({ previous: .0, event: .1, accepted: (.0.terminal || .0.phase > 16 || (.0.failed && .0.phase != 16) ? false : ((((.0.phase == 16 ? (.1 is command || .1 is closed) : false) || ((((.0.phase == 0 || .0.phase == 10) ? (.1 is closed ? true : (.1 is permit ? ((.1.permit.block_size == 512 && .1.permit.count == 1) && (.1.permit.lba == 0 && .1.permit.ordinal == 0)) : false)) : false)) || (.0.phase == 2 ? (.1 is control ? .1.control.descriptor : false) : false))) || ((((.0.phase == 3 || .0.phase == 6) || (.0.phase == 7 || .0.phase == 8)) ? (.1 is control ? .1.control.ack : false) : false) || (((.0.phase == 4 || .0.phase == 12) ? (.1 is write ? (.1.write is completed ? .1.write.completed.actual == 31 : false) : false) : false) || (.0.phase == 5 ? (.1 is read ? (.1.read.result is stalled) : false) : false)))) || ((.0.phase == 13 ? (.1 is read ? (.1.read.result is completed ? (((.1.read.data && .1.read.ordinal == 1) && (.1.read.result.completed.actual == 512 && !.1.read.result.completed.short))) : false) : false) : false) || ((.0.phase == 14 ? (.1 is read ? (.1.read.result is completed ? (((.1.read.status && .1.read.ordinal == 2) && (.1.read.tag == 2 && (.1.read.residue == 0 && .1.read.status_code == 0)))) : false) : false) : false) || ((.0.phase == 9 ? (.1 is settled ? (.1.settled.stalled ? (((.1.settled.block_size == .0.permit.block_size && .1.settled.count == .0.permit.count) && (.1.settled.lba == .0.permit.lba && .1.settled.ordinal == .0.permit.ordinal))) : false) : false) : false) || (.0.phase == 15 ? (.1 is settled ? (.1.settled.completed ? ((((.1.settled.block_size == .0.permit.block_size && .1.settled.count == .0.permit.count) && (.1.settled.lba == .0.permit.lba && .1.settled.ordinal == .0.permit.ordinal)) && ((.1.settled.actual == 512 && .1.settled.residue == 0) && (!.1.settled.short && .1.settled.length == 512)))) : false) : false) : false)))))) })

plot bot-reentry-advance (
    transition: BotReentryTransition...| >> state: BotReentryState...|
) = ({ bank: .previous.bank, request: (.accepted && .event is permit ? { block_size: .event.permit.block_size, count: .event.permit.count, lba: .event.permit.lba } : .previous.request), permit: (.accepted && .event is permit ? .event.permit : .previous.permit), data: (.accepted && .previous.phase == 13 ? (.event is read ? .event.read.result : .previous.data) : .previous.data), phase: (.accepted && .event is closed ? 17 : (!.accepted || .previous.phase >= 16 ? 16 : (.previous.phase == 0 ? 2 : (.previous.phase == 10 ? 12 : .previous.phase + 1)))), failed: (.previous.failed || !.accepted), terminal: (!.accepted || (.accepted && .event is closed)) })
plot bot-reentry-emission (
    transition: BotReentryTransition...| >> emission: BotReentryEmission...|
) = (.accepted && (.previous.phase == 9 || .previous.phase == 15) ? (.event is settled ? emit(empty) : absent(empty)) : absent(empty))
plot bot-storage-read-reentry (
    request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B >> result: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) {
 literal: bytes/literal("55534243010000000002000080000a2800000000000000010000000000000055534243020000000002000080000a28000000000000000100000000000000")
